name: optimize_go_regex_compile_in_loop
description: Optimizes a validator that recompiles the same regexp on every call to compiling it once
prompts: CountValid(lines []string) int in validator.go counts how many strings in lines match the email-like pattern `^user-\d+@example\.com$`. It calls regexp.MustCompile(pattern) INSIDE the loop, once per line - recompiling (parsing + building the automaton for) the same fixed pattern on every call is wasted work and makes the function far too slow for large inputs. Rewrite CountValid so the regexp is compiled ONCE (e.g. compiled outside the loop, or as a package-level var) and reused for every line, while returning the exact same count. Keep the function name and signature.
